notes.title: UPDATE 53 IS HERE
notes.content:
Update 53 has arrived! Let’s dive into its secrets!
   
DRONE & MECH UPGRADES
1. CHIPS LEVEL UP
- Levelling-up chips is the newest addition to Drone and Mech Programming. 
- You can level up chips by fusing them to other chips and connectors, which can massively amplify their bonus!  
- When a chip is at max level, the Motherboard bonus will also be boosted.
- A crucial advantage of this new mechanic is that, once you level up a chip, you can reroll its base stat. 
- To level up a chip, you must fuse it to another chip of the same type and bonus.  
- To start, tap on an already socketed chip on the motherboard and use the Fuse button to go to the Fusing menu. You can select the chip you want to use from the list of chips you own.
- You can also use connectors as a fusing material. You will only see connectors with the same rarity as the one socketed to the chip on the motherboard.   
- The rarity is determined by the number of connections.  
- If your chip is socketed with a rare 2-sided connector, then only another rare connector can be used for fusing.
- Depending on the rarity, the connectors multiply the XP value provided by the chip.
- The chips and connectors used for fusion are destroyed, providing you with XP. 

2. UPGRADED MOTHERBOARD BONUSES
We upgraded four of the Motherboard bonuses. They will directly impact the base stats of the Drones and Mechs, rather than the bonuses, making them much more dominant in battle.

They have no unit ratio condition and will be permanently active.     

Here are the update bonuses:
- Increases Drone's Base Damage by X% and reduces its Base Health by Y%. 
- Increases Mech's Base Damage by X% and reduces its Base Health by Y%. 
- Increases Drone's Base Health by X% and reduces its Base Damage by Y%. 
- Increases Mech's Base Health by X% and reduces its Base Damage by Y%

3. BATTLE REPORT UPGRADE
We've added data about the impact of all Motherboard bonuses to Battle Reports so you can enjoy a better overview of how your army performed. 

4. PROGRAMMING MENU UPGRADE
- We modified the main Programming menu to show all the elements that scale the Motherboard bonuses. 
- You will see the Base Motherboard bonus, the Chip-Slot Match bonus, the bonus for a max level chip, and the bonus for matching all the chips to all the slots.

5. ADVANCED RESEARCH
- This new type of Research gives you various bonuses that are much more powerful than the original Research. 
- Advanced Research will become available when you reach a certain level of the Research Institute.  
- To start using it, you'll need the new Violetium Essence. Other than this, Advanced Research works the same way as the original one.

LUNAR DASH FESTIVITIES
a)	The Lunar Dash Chain Event: Join the daily events during the holiday period and get explosive rewards by fighting your way to the top of the leaderboard!

b)	The Spring Festival Mini-Game: Dive into the Spring Festival mini-game by hunting down the Pagodas and Independence Day Fireworks all over the World Map. Gather as many as possible and get the hidden Golden Coins!  
Exchange them with the exclusive Festive Trader, available only during the Chinese New Year event, to get exclusive prizes.

c)	Offensive Commander Skins
-	Brynjar M3 will enhance Cross-World Unit Health by 10%.
-	The formidable Mastiff M3 skin will increase Armored Units Armor by 10%.

d)	Base Decorations
- The Crimson Temple will boost your Defensive Army Size by 3%.
- The Azure Skyscraper will give you 10% bonus damage when defending.
- The Gross Bulwark will enhance your Resource Production Speed by 10%.

e)	Defensive Commander Skin
-	The epic Dragon Trasher defensive skin will enhance the Building and Research Speed.

f)	Offensive Lunar Items
- Commander Volsky's Coral Blaster will еnhance the armor of all units in Faction Wars with its first bonus. Its second bonus will increase points received from Kill-Enemies events. Its random properties will be from the Utility, Offensive, and Defensive pools. Its second and third random bonuses will be Faction Wars-related.

- Ylva’s mighty Motion XLR will boost your health when defending during Cross-World events. Its second set bonus increases your health when defending. The item’s random properties will be drawn from Offensive, Commander, and Defensive pools. The first and last of those bonuses will be Cross-World-related.

- Commander Grahn's Crimson Alarm STM will amplify your Mech units with its set bonuses. The first bonus is Faction-War-related, boosting Mech HP during these battles. The second bonus enhances Mech armor. Its random properties will be drawn from the Faction Wars and the general pools of defensive bonuses.

g)	Of course, we will celebrate the Lunar Dash with exclusive avatars, emojis, and frames.

THE WARMONGER RENEGADES
The new PvE season brings exciting action and explosive items.
a) Offensive Items 
- Commander Walker's Junker Plate ZT has two set bonuses that enhance your health when defending and your Commander’s HP. If you upgrade the item further, you will enjoy its random bonuses from the Defensive, Commander, and Utility pools.
- Lian Qing's Hardened Bulwark K2: This Armor Upgrade focuses on Cross-World Events. The Bulwark boosts Cross-World Damage as its first bonus and Cross-World Aerial Health as its second bonus. Its random properties will be drawn from the Cross-World Offensive and Defensive pools.

b) Defensive Item
- The Scavenged Companion boosts the defender’s HP as its first set bonus, and Army size as its second. Its random properties will be drawn from the Defensive bonus pool.

NEW ENGINEER SET ITEMS
The Engineer Set gets four powerful additions:
- The Tactical Kit M1 will increase your Drones' damage as its primary bonus and the Commander’s Health with its secondary bonus. Its random properties will be drawn from the Defensive and Commander pools. 

- The Cybernetic Eye will boost your Mechs' Health as its first set bonus and the damage of all units as its second. The item’s random bonuses will be drawn from the Offensive and Defensive pools.

- The Cobalt Rockets’ set bonuses are Mech-focused, boosting Mechs' Armor and Health. Its random bonuses will be Defensive or Offensive. 

- The Engineer Pet amplifies the Commander's Damage with its primary stat and damage of your Drones with its secondary one. The item’s random bonuses will be drawn from the Offensive, Defensive, and Commander pools.

notes.title: UPDATE 52 has arrived!
notes.content:
Hello, General! Update 52 arrives with powerful buffs, action-packed events and holiday gifts!
1.	EPIC UNIT BUFFS:
A)	DRONES & MECHS BUFF:
The HP and Damage of all drones and mechs are improved by 50%. 
The resources needed for their production are changed accordingly.   

B)	UNITS BUFF:  We also increased The Health and Damage of the Armored, Artillery, Assault, and Aerial units by 25%.  

2.	THE DEFENSIVE FORMATION! 
This Formation presents a separate army that has the honor of defending your base 
You can select the specific units that will participate in your Defense, just like you would deploy an attacking army 
Here are some key pointers: 
-	Commander Trasher will always lead your defensive formation
-	You can appoint different lieutenants to the formation 
-	You can set your Defensive Formation from the new section of Commander Trasher’s building. 
-	In the menu, you can choose the type of units you want to use and their quantity. 
-	You can select the units in your formation by type and tier.  
-	You can pick the selection format - precise numbers or percentage-based.  
-	Your total number of units in the Defensive Formation must be equal to the Defensive Army Limit.  
-	You can increase the limit by leveling up your HQ or by upgrading Trasher’s new passive skills, the new sentinel passive skills, and the two new research types.  
-	All units you choose for your defensive formation are not locked, and you can use them for other activities. They will be selected to defend only if they are available when a battle against your base starts.   
-	If the units from the formation are unavailable, backup ones will replace them. 
-	You also select the units for your backup. For example, you can choose the ones you have the highest amount of. 
-	If you are attacked, and your original defensive army is not enough, this reserve activates and fills the gap with units.   
-	If the backup units are also insufficient, the ones from the Auto-fill option will take the missing spots. 
-	You can decide if the game should auto-fill your formation using the units with the highest or the lowest might.          

3.	LIEUTENANT BUTCH
The new Lieutenant is an Assault Specialist with powerful special abilities, baseline stats, and a tree of passive bonuses focused on boosting the Assault units.  
His first unique skill provides damage reduction to your assault units against attacks from the enemy commander.   
The second ability of Lieutenant Butch increases the damage to a random backline or commander unit for several turns when your enemy casts an ability.   
 As with every lieutenant, you need to reach Base Level 22 to have the option to unlock him.

4.	THE WINTER FESTIVITIES
12 DAYS OF GIFTS
Make sure you log in every day from the 13th to the 25th of December. Because daily gifts await everyone who logs in during the 12 days till Christmas countdown!   

THE WINTER RUMBLE CHAIN EVENT
 If you like the holiday action, join the epic events of the WINTER RUMBLE Chain, packed with time-limited exclusive rewards.    
- Winter Rumble Part 1 starts on December 21 and ends on December 27 
- Winter Rumble Part 2 will celebrate the New Year festivities, starting on December 29 and ending on January 2nd 
 Follow our social media channels and in-game news for the full schedule and world brackets.  

GIFT-HUNTING MINI-GAME
 The holiday madness also brings a gift-hunting mini-game. An army of wrapped presents will spawn on the World Map. 
-	Gather them and get the deliciously valuable Gingerbread Cookies hiding there!   
-	Exchange them with the exclusive Jolly Trader for super sweet and time-limited spoils of war.   
-	The presents will also give you points for the connected Holiday Rush event, decorating you with even more rewards.
 
NEW YEAR GEAR SET ITEMS
a)	The Mech XM4S 
- Brings Unit Damage with its first bonus. While its second boosts the Commander's HP. 
- Its random properties are from the Defensive, Offensive, Commander, and Utility pools 

b)	The Snowflake Rockets. 
- This Weapon System boosts Unit Health and Commander Damage with its set bonuses. 
- Its random ones are from the Offensive, Defensive, and Commander pools.

HOLIDAY OFFENSIVE ITEM
The Velvet Aegis is the new offensive item of Commander Grahn.  
- Its first set bonus gives Artillery Health 
- The secondary one provides Unit Health  
- Its random properties come from the Defensive and Commander Pools 

HOLIDAY DECORATIONS
a)	Bonus-enhanced Base Decorations:
-	The Festive Shrine with a 10% Unit Production Speed bonus
-	The Convivial Spire with a 10% Repair Speed bonus
-	The Twin Blades Fortress with a 5% Health when Defending bonus 

b)	Defensive Commander Skins
-	Festive Trasher decks the halls and increases the Defensive Army Size.  
-	Icebite Trasher cools things down with Health and Damage when Defending. 

c)	Avatars, emojis, and frames 

 All of these you can win only during the Winter Rumble, so make sure you take part in the action-packed events.  

DEFENSIVE COMMANDER BONUSES
A)	We added five passive bonuses to Commander Trasher’s Specialization Tree.                
-	The Offensive ones boost the damage to your Mechs and Drones in defensive situations. 
-	The two new defensive skills boost the health of your defending drones and mechs 
-	The fifth skill is Utility-focused and gives Bonus Defensive Army Size. 

B)	New Defensive Commander Sentinel Rank Skills:
We updated Trasher’s Sentinel Rank with three active skills and their related passive ones. All active skills have to be activated by you. They have a cooldown period before you can use them again. 
-	The first one gives you a Retrieval Rate bonus during province capital fights for a certain time.  
-	The second one instantly repairs the damaged units in your garage for free.               
-	The third active skill is also very exciting. Every time you defeat a PVE enemy, you will receive resources.  When you activate the skill, you will get the resources you stacked. 

 Check out all the Sentinel Rank upgrades of Commander Trasher in-game. 

OFFENSIVE COMMANDER UNIT SKINS 
The Mjolnir tank of Commander Grahn gets two new skins, each with an explosive bonus. 
-	Mjolnir Prime boosts Commander Damage
-	Mjolnir M2 increases the Artillery damage

Narwhal, the iron bird of Commander Qing also gets royal treatment with these bonus-boosted skins. 
-	Narwhal Prime buffs Commander Damage When Attacking
-	Narwhal M2 boosts Aerial Damage

NEW RENEGADE SEASON: 
The CRIMSON HUNT is back!   
The bloodthirsty bring fierce PVE challenges and one new item to their gear set.  
The Drone XM4S Companion enhances your HP and Damage with its set bonuses 
The item’s random bonuses will be from the Offensive and Defensive pools. 

THE NEW FACTION WARS SEASON:
Season 10 will bring new rules, fresh milestones to conquer, and rewards to earn.  
Stay tuned for more info about it on our social channels 

PVP BALANCE CHANGES: 
 Our team kept an eye on battles all year and decided to give back the spotlight to the offense in all types of PVP clashes.    
a)	PVP battles:
-	The Attacker’s Damaged Units Ratio increases from 0% to 25% 
-	Attacker’s Destroyed Units Ratio drops from 55% to 35% 
-	The Defender’s Damaged Units Ratio decreases from 55% to 50%   
-	The Defender’s Destroyed Units Ratio changes from 0% to 10%. This means you might have destroyed units after an enemy attack.  
 So, make sure to optimize the new Defensive Formation we showed you earlier in the video. 

LIEUTENANT BALANCE CHANGES:
• Ballistic Bulldog’S first ability chance to add a power-up was increased by 10% at each rank, and the power up will cast 14 projectiles instead of 12. 
• The stun chance of Tyreese Coleman's first ability was increased by 1% per rank (for a total of 25% per stack at legendary rarity) 
• Ayaka's first ability armor reduction was increased by 1% per rank (for a total of -20% after each attack)
• Kitty's Damage augment for her first skill has been increased by 10% at each rank.
• Kitty's second ability chance to fire at an additional target has been boosted by 20% at rank 1 and 25% at rank 2 (for a total of 70% at legendary rarity). Its damage was also increased by 20% in both ranks (for a total of 80% at legendary rarity).

COMMANDER BALANCE CHANGES:
-	Trasher's survival rate when defending skill from the defensive specialization was reduced from 1% to 0.5% per rank  
-	Volsky's Iron Veil global ability ratio decreases from 65% to 35% 

THE GREEN MIST UPGRADE
The event and weather duration were changed from 4h to 3h
The weather’s negative bonus to the Commander Damage was changed from -50 to -100%
The lifetime duration of the Xenon deposits was changed from 12 mins to 13 mins
If you successfully attack and defeat another player gathering resources on a Xenon deposit in the Green Mist, you will steal 30% instead of 20% of their collected resources. Even in defeat, players retain 50% of what they have accumulated.
We also made changes to the overall rewards.

notes.title: Update 51 is here!
notes.content:
Update 51 has arrived, General! Let's dive into its secrets!

1. DRONE & MECH UPGRADES

1.1 New Drones & Mechs Event
Welcome to the new Programming Event! This event grants points for socketing connectors and chips, enhancing your units and commanders.

1.2 Two New Motherboard Chips
One of the most exciting additions in this update is the introduction of two chip types: Unique and Joker. 

a) Unique Chips: These unique chips are limited to one per motherboard and provide an impactful permanent bonus to your units and commanders. They come with a matching slot on the motherboard. Fill with the corresponding chip to increase the motherboard bonus, following the established motherboard logic.

b) The Joker Chip bonus has a crucial advantage, although its bonus is not as powerful as regular chips, in that you can place the Joker in any motherboard slot. Its strength is that the Joker allows you to bypass the slot color restrictions and get the most out of your motherboard bonus by fulfilling the matching requirements of the slots.

c) Getting the New Chips
- Unique Chips can be obtained from chip chests of Epic rarity, adding another layer of strategy to your gameplay. 
- Joker Chips are part of the Rare chip chest pool.
- Unique and Joker chips are also available in the Rare mixed chest, giving you more ways to customize your units and commanders.

1.3 Salvaging Connectors
You can now salvage connectors from the Programming building, fine-tune your setups, and maximize your strategies.

1.4 Debris Changes 
- The loot from your damaged units has been reduced by 50%.
- The Debris earned from units killed by your army will get you 5% of the total kills as Debris, enhancing this crucial resource.

1.5 Visual Upgrades
- We added visual elements to identify socketing and connecting chips, making it easier to see and manage your upgrades.
- Drones and Mechs have now been added to the World Map army marches, offering an even more immersive experience during battles.


2. LIEUTENANT KITTY IS HERE
Lieutenant Kitty is joining the battle, and she is here to lead your Drones to victory. 

Her first ability increases your Drones' survivability, granting them a dodge chance and a damage boost after dodging an attack. 

Her second ability allows your Drones to fire at an additional target, always targeting the strongest enemy stack of units.

Like her colleagues, Lieutenant Kitty also has a Specialization Talent Tree of passive bonuses, which we will review in an upcoming YouTube video. Stay tuned!


3. NEW ADDITIONS TO THE ENGINEER SET
- The Ammunition will boost Mech Health with its primary set stat, and Drone Damage with its secondary stat. Its first two random bonuses come from the offensive bonus pool, and the last two emerge from the defensive one.

- The Exoskeleton brings Drone Damage as its first set bonus and Mech HP as its second. Its first two properties are defensive, and the last two are offensive.

- We move on to the Companion item, which offers Mech Damage and Health as its set bonuses. Its random bonuses come from the Commander, Offensive, and Defensive pools. 

- The two set bonuses of the Engineer's Implant boost the Health and Damage of the Drones. Its random properties also emerge from the Commander, Offensive, and Defensive pools. 


4. COMMANDER KOPKA'S NEW OFFENSIVE ITEM
This Weapon System offensive item will boost the Damage of all units with its primary bonus and enhance the Commanders' Armor with its secondary bonus. 

Its random properties will come from the Commander Utility and Defensive bonus pools.

notes.title: THE DRONES & MECHS ARE HERE - UPDATE 50 NOTES
notes.content:
Welcome to the future of warfare, General! Update 50 is here! Let’s dive into its game-changing elements!

1. THE DRONE & THE MECH UNITS

Ground-breaking new units are here to revolutionize the game, transform your battle strategy, and provide you with the extraordinary ability to turn the tides in any battle.

The DRONES are deadly offensive units that strike from above.
The MECHS are defensive-oriented war machines.

The Drones and Mechs are unique because you can customize them with new, cutting-edge Programming, which allows you to obtain and enhance various crucial bonuses.

On top of the standard unit stats, the Drones and Mechs have exclusive Passive Skills!
DRONES:
- Odd-numbered tier Drones, AKA Hornets, deal bonus damage when attacking. 
- The Valkyries, or the even-numbered tier Drones, provide bonus armor when attacking.
 
MECHS
- The odd-tier Mantis Mech units boost damage when defending.
- The Myrmidons, or the even-tier Mechs, enhance armor when defending.

1.1 DRONE & MECH PROGRAMMING
- The Drones and Mechs have a unique motherboard with seven slots and ten connections.

- By socketing chips to the motherboard’s slots, you can enhance and customize the new units from the inside with various formidable Offensive and Defensive bonuses. 

- Each chip has a percentage range for the impact of its bonus.

- You can massively increase this range by adding connector items to the chip.

- When you socket a chip to a slot on the motherboard, its bonus is activated and takes a random percentage from its current range.

- You can increase the final bonus by connecting the chip to other chips on the motherboard.
 
- The motherboard also has a special MOTHERBOARD BONUS that boosts all units from a particular type in your active army by transferring a percentage of their bonus from one unit type to another. For example, a bonus might apply 40% of your armored damage to your Aerial HP. 

- The transfer bonus stacks on top of what you already have, so it doesn't remove or decrease your existing enhancements.

- Receiving the full power of the motherboard bonus depends on the percentage of Drones or Mechs you have in your active army. 

- The motherboard bonuses come with a condition: To benefit from their full power, you must have a certain percentage of Drones or Mechs in battle. Operating with a smaller quantity than that which is requested for the specific bonus will result in a weaker effect. 

- The type of bonus will define which unit, between Drones and Mechs, must join your army. 

- You will best benefit from the Programming if you vary your army to maximize your bonus transfer!

- The motherboard bonus can be further increased by socketing chips to their matching color-coded slots.

- If all seven slots have the correct chips installed, the motherboard bonus increases even more.

1.2 PROGRAMMING CENTER
The programming of the Drones and Mechs occurs in the new Programming Center, unlocked at HQ level 24.

This new addition will provide you with 2 means to increase your bonuses - Motherboard bonus and Chips

 
1.3 BUILDING DRONES AND MECHS
- You can craft the new units in the Unit Factory. 
- Repairs and modernization take place in the Garage.
- The first two tiers require the standard resources used for building units.
- To build Tier 11-15 drones and mechs you would need the new Debris Parts
- To unlock Debris, you need to build the Programming Center.
- Debris accumulates from destroyed units in combat. 
- To unlock in-battle Debris, you must reach level 4 of the Programming Center.
- You can also get Debris by salvaging chips and connectors.

A detailed tutorial on the Drones and the Mechs is coming to YouTube this week, so subscribe to WPO’s channel and stay tuned.


2. THE DRONES & MECHS CRAFTING SET
The new units keep on giving with a menacing Engineer Gear Set:
a) The Mk-Defender is an Armor Upgrade that provides a Health bonus to Mech units as its primary bonus.
- Its second set bonus enhances Mech Damage.

b) The Accuracy Enhancer boosts Drone Damage with its first bonus.
- The item’s second bonus increases Drone Health.

c) The Elektro Crates boost Mech HP as their primary bonus. 
Their secondary bonus provides extra Health to all units.

d) The R4il-GUN X7 weapon system increases Drone Damage as its first bonus.
Its second bonus boosts the damage of all units.

The non-fixed random properties of all four items come from the Offensive or Defensive pools. Check each pool in-game for more details.
 

3. LIEUTENANT AYAKA
The first Mech Lieutenant has two powerful Special Skills.
a) The first skill is Offensive: Every Mech auto-attack stacks a permanent armor debuff on its target.
 
b) The second skill is defense-focused: Ayaka casts a shield on your Mech units equal to a certain percentage of the Commander's Health.
 
c) The lieutenant also has a mighty skill tree of passive bonuses that focus on further boosting the Mech units. 
 
4. HALLOWEEN MAYHEM
Join the scary-good festivities from 10/29 to 11/5. 
 
a) THE SPOOKY CARNIVAL CHAIN EVENT will bring uncanny action with daily events throughout the festive week.
Conquer the daily events and milestones, and climb the overall event leaderboard to fill your bag with the sweetest rewards.
 
b) THE HAUNTING MINI-GAME: At the same time, Spooky Jacks will spawn on the World Map. Gather them and get our holiday currency -- Halloween Candy. Exchange your candies with the Festive Trader and choose from his sweet bounty.

c) A sinister Halloween Defensive Commander Skin for Trasher 
  
d) Two Base Decorations with powerful bonuses that will focus on increasing damage when attacking and damage when defending

e) Two frightening avatars and a gothic frame


5. THE OFFENSIVE COMMANDERS UNIT SKINS
a) Basilisk Prime: The Halloween-inspired skin for Commander Kopka’s war beast provides 15% more Army Speed.
b) Basilisk M2 increases Assault Health by 10%.
c) The breathtaking Corso Prime skin for Commander Walker’s airplane has a +20% Gathering Speed bonus.
d) The Corso M2 skin will increase Commander Damage by 6%.


6. THE VIXEN FORCE
The Vixen Force Renegades join the game! Alongside their brutality, the vicious Vixens will bring: 
- An action-packed limited-time event! 
- A stunning Base Decoration with an extra 10% HP when Attacking
- A new emoji and a frame

7. COMMANDER CHANGES:
- Kopka's auto-targeting Turret add-on duration was decreased from 3 to 1 turn.
- Walker can now target commanders as part of his random targeting base attack.

8. KILL-ENEMIES EVENT SCORING
- Killing units on deposits no longer awards points during The Kill-Enemies event.
- Battles that last less than 3 turns will not count towards Kill-Enemies event scoring.
- If the side that loses in less than 3 turns has an army of more than 500,000 units, the battle will still count towards Kill-Enemies event scoring.

Note that the Kill-Enemies event scoring includes all chain and standalone Kill-Enemies events as well as the Cross-World Conflict event.

9. MISC: 
- Research for HQ level 36 can now be visualized in the research institute and will be unlocked at world HQ 35. It features extended offensive, defensive, economical, Cross-world, and Faction Wars researches.
- The resource capacity of all regional deposits has been increased by 50%.


Stay tuned for our upcoming video, where we will reveal the final piece and the last gift code of the Update 50 puzzle. Be one of the first 100 players to redeem it, and get exclusive Drone & Mech gifts!

notes.title: THE ANNIVERSARY UPDATE 48 IS HERE

notes.title: Update 45: The Weather System
notes.content:
Update 45 is storming out on the frontline!  
1. THE WEATHER SYSTEM: This brand-new epic feature will harness the power of nature to change it all!   
- Blizzards, Snow Storms, Heatwaves and everything in between will hit WPO! Each type of weather will provide different bonuses in PvP and PvE modes, respectively.  
- All weather phenomena will have stunning visual effects, visible on your base, on the map and during battle. You can enable or disable them at will in Settings. 
- The weather changes will appear over small groups composed of several regions for a given period of time.  
- The Weather System will have a unique map view, accessible through the new Weather icon in the Provinces section. 
- The affected batch of regions will be color-coded depending on the weather type.   
- By tapping on a region, you'll be able to see the current weather and bonuses for the entire group. 

a) Weather Types 
Every weather type simultaneously has both positive and negative bonuses. The ONLY EXCEPTION is Sunny weather, which brings only a positive bonus in buffing the Army Speed. 

Here is the complete list of Weather types coming with Update 45:
- Violent Winds will influence Commander Damage positively and Aerial Health negatively.  
- When a Blizzard arrives, it enhances Defender Unit Damage while giving a negative bonus to Attacker Unit Health. 
- Rain pours a positive bonus over Artillery Damage and a debuff over Armored Damage. 
- When a Storm hits, it boosts Assault Damage, while Artillery Damage receives a negative bonus. 
- Snow increases Aerial Health and decreases Assault Damage. 
- Snow Storms give a positive bonus to Armored Damage and decrease Commander Damage. 
- Sand Storms debuff Attacker Unit Damage, while Defender Unit Health is increased. 
- If Drought affects a region, it decreases the Resource Production Speed, but it also buffs Unit Damage. 
- Heatwaves boost Gathering Speed as a positive bonus, but give a negative bonus to Commander Health. 

b) Weather Effects: The Weather System will also have some curious anomalies affecting different places.  
- The OASIS, caused by the Heatwave, spawns additional unique deposits with instant gathering ability. The first player to reach it will collect everything without gathering time. The Xenon-X deposits, revealed by the Oasis, will be unlocked at World HQ Lv. 10. You must be at least Lv. 30 to collect Xenon-X.

The Points of Interest (POI) are specific forts on the Faction Wars map with unique Effects that spawn powerful buffs or items. The Effects have two categories: Normal and Special.
Normal effects:
• Give Positive Bonuses.
• Only one effect at a time can be applied by a player. Taking another will cancel the previous one.

Special effects:
• Special effects do not cancel any already obtained effects.
• There is no limit to how many times a player can obtain them.
• Have an instant effect.

There are two types of POI Effects: Personal and Fort ones.
a) Personal Effects (Affect only a single player):
WEAPONS FACTORY - Normal effect that spawns Positive Buffs. The Buff is active until the end of the War, or until the player picks another Normal Effect.
ARMORY - Normal Effect that spawns Positive Buffs. The Buff is active until the end of the War, or until the player picks another Normal effect.

b) Fort effects (Active only for the players in the POI fort):
POWERHOUSE - Instant Special Effect that gives a Positive Buff at the start of the War. It affects only the members of the defending faction in the fort. The Buff lasts until the end of the Faction War and does not cancel any other obtained buffs.
DEBRIS - Instant Special Effect that gives a Negative Buff at the start of the War. It affects only the members of the defending faction in the fort. The Buff lasts until the end of the Faction War and does not cancel any other obtained buffs.

notes.title: Update 9 Changelogs
notes.content:
Update 9 has been deployed and it’s promising exciting new challenges for the year 2019. The holiday cheer will be in the air too, with special winter events that will undoubtedly elevate your spirits! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31144110/f1149c3c97f3373745dc101c469e596db7c30cb2.jpg[/img]

[h1] World HQ[/h1]
Join forces and work together for the construction of the new World HQ – the most vital building yet. It will serve as a symbol of a new beginning and as a seat of power for the global leaders.  The Faction that completes the task first will be able to select one out of 4 given World policies which will be enacted immediately and affect each and every base in the World!  
The players have to complete 4 special Faction Chain Events in order to build and unlock the World HQ. After each build chain event the winning faction will need to choose one policy that will take effect till the end of the next build chain event. Also, after each stage of chain events, the World HQ will upgrade visually. 

Voting
•	If your Faction has won the Chain Event, you will be presented with a Policy Choice. 
•	Simply go to your Faction menu -> Manage -> Vote
•	You can then browse through the different policy types, choose to vote for one of the Policies, check how many votes each Policy has and check the time remaining for voting
•	Note that you can vote only once and you will not be able to change your mind after you cast your vote.
•	Players with a Lieutenant Faction Rank and above will be eligible to cast their votes. If you leave your Faction or join another one during the voting, you won’t be able to vote. 
•	If there is a tie between certain policies, a random policy between those ones will be chosen.

[h1]Cross-World Assault Event – new rules inspired by your feedback! [/h1]
This time protecting what’s yours will really pay off! Sentinel points will now be awarded to Factions who have not only successfully attacked other player’s capitals but also defended their own. Thus, the event points received and the rewards will depend on the level of the defended capitals. 
•	The sentinel points will be 5 per faction capital level controlled at the end of the event.
•	The event points for capital control will be 500 per capital level controlled every 1 hour. 
There will be an additional reward for the winning World in the Cross-World Assault event – i.e. the new World HQ Policies will be empowered. 

[h1]Ho-ho-holiday Activities (24 December – 1 January) [/h1]
•	These winter holidays, presents will lurk from every corner. Send a commander to collect them and receive the new delicious and valuable currency – the Gingerbread Cookies. Don’t get short of them and pile them up to exchange them for awesome stuff at the Trader. He will arrive at your base in a festive zeppelin and an outfit designed especially for the winter celebrations! 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31144110/a15ae58daf25a4b93933aaab36e17def3ce6efae.jpg[/img]
•	There will be also a week-long winter Chain Event which will consist of the following Grand events:
[list]
 [*]Gather Resources 
 [*]Lucky Spin  
 [*]Commander XP 
 [*]Build Units 
 [*]Kill Enemies 
[/list]
•	Be on the lookout for the updated Lucky Wheel holiday edition with some refreshed content! 

[h1]The Vixen Force – the new renegades [/h1]
The pink is not dead and they are coming in their full splendor to prove it. But don’t be fooled by their pretty looks. The ladies from the Vixen Force replace the gentlemen from the Alpha Order with the promise to steamroll any enemy that stands in their way. You will spot their painted war machines all over the province map like an ominious glitter – attack and defeat them to take the new Spray Canister and craft some awesome gear for your commander!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31144110/673016b922a1d8db1a5b86fb1c68bb7bb69d5fc1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Other improvements [/h1]
•	Modernization polish – you can now manually enter the number of units that you would like to modernize; there are now notifications when a new tier for modernization is available and other UI improvements
•	Crafting menu polish - crafting gear filtering and animated crafting 
•	New item sets plus updated old item sets – be on the lookout for awesome exclusive gear
•	Chat polish – rally notifications in chat will appear only temporarily 
•	Chain Events improvements – you will be able to check all the upcoming events in the event chain and what’s your result in previous events from this chain.
•	Various bug fixes

notes.title: Update 7 Live!
notes.content:
3… 2… 1… Liftoff! Yes, we did it – Update 7 has blasted off! And so has the Rocket – one year later, its mystery is finally revealed. And its destination? Read on and find out!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31144110/e4484e27f079efb9f78cc8d63ecdca899150cead.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Road to Space [/h1]
The time has come, Generals – the Space Center has finally started its operations! Watch the Rocket finally fly off to the Orbital Command – your Faction’s newest super weapon! 
Launch your rocket as often as possible to upgrade your Faction’s Orbital Command. Levelling it up will unlock unique strategic abilities and bonuses that will provide cosmic support for the ground operations of your Faction. 
Use space missions to send Construction Supplies and Core Energy to the Orbital Command. 
The Orbital Command is unlocked as soon as the Faction is created. It consists of one Orbital Command Core and 5 unique Modules which provide 5 passive bonuses and 5 active abilities to all faction members.When you upgrade a Module you increase the power of its ability. Each Module and its respective ability have 30 levels. 
Only Faction leaders can activate Orbital Command’s abilities and decide which one to use and how to deploy it. Now, charged and ready to go, nothing can stand in your way! 

[h1]Equipment presets[/h1]
Easily switch between presets so you always have the right loadout for the task at hand. It’s as easy as 1-2-3! Unlock more Preset slots as you advance in the game. Concentrate more on their strategic and tactical decisions, while removing the need to micro-manage equipment before each mission.
In order for Presets to be applicable, you must have your VIP Status Active. After your VIP expires, the last used preset will become your default one and every other preset will be locked.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31144110/8f7021b9bc86963497a885587bb279b4d8aee67f.png[/img]

[h1]Renegade Invasion [/h1]
Nothing brings people closer than a common enemy. Now it’s time for the true leaders to step forward, and lead their factions into a united front against the Renegade Bases.
All faction members will now receive additional Sentinel XP reward based on the number and level of capitals  they control at the end of the event and during the event all renegade bases will get the overpowered bonus that will increase their army bonuses with (50%) and rewards.

[h1]Faction Event Rework[/h1]
We have reworked the faction event reward system so that it now benefits the active players. Now, a faction member should first reach all the event milestones in order to receive the leaderboard rewards his/her faction has won.  

[h1]The Marauders [/h1]
They despise order, break all rules and hate new leaders. Pure destruction is running in their veins and their sole calling is killing and looting what’s not theirs. Hunt down the Marauders and purge your lands from the pest. Gather great spoils of war and use them to create new highly valuable seasonal gear for your Commander.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31144110/5c2b9fbceb5c17d0668c38b8324a42c6ee4df887.jpg[/img]

[h1]QoL[/h1]
[list]
[*]Boss Renegades – Meet the Level 6 Bosses – they are 3 times stronger than the Level 5 ones but they give 4 times more Commander XP
[*]Renegades – they are now slightly buffed but the rewards they give have been increased 
[*]Capital Guards - Level 3+ bonuses increased; Level 4+ bonuses and unit count increased
[*]Capital Defenders (player controlled garrisons) - Unit tiers adjusted; Bonuses increased
[*]2 new avatars added 
[*]Sentinel XP reset voucher added to the in-game shop 
[/list]

notes.title: Update 6 Deployed!
notes.content:
The battlefield will be the hottest place this summer, Generals, as Update 6 has now been deployed! It comes fully loaded with glorious decorations, a brand new World vs. World event, and the brutal Renegades from S.I.G.M.A.! 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31144110/2a2630bef513d5aed04c5e2f20395d898b2af77d.png[/img]

[h1] World Assault [/h1]
All the war planets out there are now on a razor-edge with the new cross-world event - the World Assault. Summon all your trustworthy allies and build up a strategy to pillage other world’s provinces. Get your World to the top of the leaderboard and win exclusive spoils of war for everyone. The event will evolve in a similar fashion to the cross-world Conflict event with several differences.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31144110/2bb26a7aa4d219add483f64797ba6a20afd90131.jpg[/img]

[h1] New City Decorations, Avatars and Avatar Frames [/h1]
Do you want to be the talk of the World? Why not change the looks of your base and avatar – be sure your enemies will be all green with envy, while you gloat over your new outlook. You can choose between 4 city decorations, a lot more avatars, and brand new avatar frames. 
You should have Hologram Shards to unlock a city decoration type or exclusive avatars from the Renegade seasons. You can get those new tokens in bundles and from the Trader, once in a while, so keep a sharp eye.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31144110/03e697c4ea205735b8a62fc74b5a58ea03bebd3b.jpg[/img]

[h1] Faction Depot[/h1]
No more free lunches! From now on, players from other factions that mine on your territory will pay tax and the Faction leaders will re-distribute the collected taxes. You can amend the tax rates with the new researches - 1 more faction research - Gathering Tax, and 1 more player research - Gathering Tax Reduction.

[h1] The S.I.G.M.A Renegades are here![/h1]
Your provinces will be more war-torn and fractured than ever as the deadly threat of the S.I.G.M.A. Renegades is now creeping in! Hunt them down and gather great spoils of war that can be used to create new powerful equipment for your Defensive Commander.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31144110/b3603472c9f10d5c4c0179269412dae58774e1dc.jpg[/img]

[h1] New Sentinel Skills [/h1]
•	New active sentinel skill “Bulletproof Battle Plan” – on your next solo attack, your units are damaged instead of destroyed, up to your Garage capacity. 
•	New passive sentinel skill “Stockpiler” – gathering on your faction territory will also fill up the Faction depot (up to 10%)

[h1] Fixes and Improvements[/h1]
We carefully read your reports, Generals and we have implemented different improvements in the game.

notes.title: Update 5 Live!
notes.content:
Update 5 is here and it comes with the new explosive Cross-World Conflict event that everybody has been waiting for! Also, get ready to meet the next high-tech renegade faction, get your hands on the new set of global skills for your defensive commander and explore the totally revamped in-game chat section.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31144110/d2a55ef3454fa6002dd1fea9294fd0db3c8925ef.jpg[/img]

[h1]New event – Cross World Conflict[/h1]
Get ready to face rivals from foreign Worlds and dominate on the unknown battleground. Prove who the top dog in the galaxy is and unleash your full power! 

Rules 
•	Only players who have their HQ at level 12 or above can join the event.  
•	Players at level 11 and below can still participate in a Cross-World Conflict event when they are in their own world – they will score points by defending their bases.
•	Once, the event starts, players can transfer to another world using a special cross-world quantum teleport from the events menu.
•	The first teleport to another world is free and the return to the home world is free, too. If you require any other quantum teleports, you can get them with medals.
•	When the event starts all factions that are from the same world will be set to be in a union relationship that will last till the end of the event.
•	While players are fighting on the foreign front, their original base in their home world will be protected by a green peace shield.
•	Invading Players can attack any province they want as there is no need for the pillaged provinces to be connected.
•	During the event all battles on capitals will result in losses for both sides (this rule also applies for neutral capitals)
•	During the Cross World events players from union relationship factions can’t teleport to faction capital regions of other factions. Only the owner faction can teleport in their faction capital region.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31144110/5ebfb3e09935b6b8ba1867cbc2a0175cd7bcbfa4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Sentinel Rank[/h1]
In time of war, the right tactical choices are vital and you must use all your skills and knowledge wisely! So we are introducing a brand new global skill set for your defensive Commander - the Sentinel Rank, to encourage your military creativity. It includes 4 active skills and 14 passive skills linked to different aspects of the game – Base, Defense, World Map, Faction and Offense. 
Only the most dedicated Generals will take advantage of these new skills as unlocking them will demand special Sentinel points. You accumulate them when you level up your Sentinel rank and you level it up when you gain enough Sentinel XP by taking part in specific events and reaching the leaderboard and milestone rewards!

[h1]Chat revamped[/h1] 
Information is a necessity, communication is essential – these are the things that no General can do without. That is why we are improving one of the most important tools for this – the in-game chat. We are introducing even more fun and cool ways to express yourself: Emojis! 
In addition:
•	Global chat – no more separate topics, Generals. Talk to the whole World the same way you are doing this in your faction chat.
•	The max message length is increased to 300 characters, for those who wish to share more detailed plans with their allies.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31144110/9000749f0e40b8f14bd63063ad4fd7373a39d2a0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Meet the New Renegades from Pax Mechanica![/h1]
Meet the super intelligent and breaking bad forces of the new renegades – Pax Mechanica! Those brave enough to confront their high-tech armies and stop their tide of aggression will be rewarded lavishly with resources and cutting-edge materials! Collect as many of those as possible and craft exclusive Equipment for your Commander and you will be able to push your bonuses and Skills beyond limits!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31144110/f0df0d6422b8ba1735365f42f7186f92e38a7104.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Leaderboards[/h1]
Sometimes it’s hard to say who the best general around is. Is it the one with the most kills? The highest rank? That is why we are introducing 3 new leaderboards: Sentinel Rank, HQ Building Level, and Defensive Commander Level

[h1]QoL[/h1]
•	Faction members list scrolling 
•	Elite mines list revamped – the scrolling and order of elite mines have been fixed. Now, you can see the available mines on top of the list sorted by type
•	UI improvements – the in-game notifications have been placed better so that they won’t cover important information 
•	Added news reports for solo events

[h1]Balance changes[/h1] 
•	Earl Francis "Drop The Bomb" Global Skill Buff - Bonus 250% at level 50 and 300% at level 60 to 300% at level 50 and 350% at level 60.
•	Arvid Grahn Basic Stats Buff - Base damage increase with 2%.
•	Volsky Global "Iron Veil" Skill change- Bonus from 80% at level 50 and 90% at level 60 to 60% at level 50 and 65% for level 60. This skill will not stack with other kill dead ratio bonuses.
•	Maddy Kopka ”Laser Rifle" change  - Damage for first level reduced from 150% to 130%.

notes.title: Update 4 Deployed!
notes.content:
Hi Generals, 
Update 4 has been deployed and it’s fully loaded with super cool stuff to further spice up your combat! Five more commander abilities, a Trader from a far-away world, army presets, new Deployment Platform building and Thorium Cult renegades all make their debut to challenge your military prowess in the war for global conquest!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31144110/1af64fa8a16db73187fa559fd5abaf47234f346e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Commander’s Global Skills[/h1]
The tactical combat has a new dimension! Unlock the new Commanders’ powerful skills and give your army the winning edge. You unlock them instantly once your commanders reach level 50 and you activate them straight from the deployment menu – just bear in mind that each skill has a 24-hour cooldown. 

[h1]The Thorium Cult – the New Evil Renegades[/h1]
The fanatic forces of “Magna Thoria” are coming to storm your World.  Led by their lunatic vicious queen Deia Thoria they will steamroll anyone standing in their way to harvest the precious Thorium. Don’t leave them invicta – destroy them and collect the Unstable Thorium to create devastating weaponry for your Aerial units!  

[h1]The Trader[/h1]
А new shop has opened doors in your Base. It will welcome the Trader and his zeppelin loaded with unseen goods and supplies. These could be highly desirable power-ups, exclusive boosts, basic and advanced crafting materials from the current Renegade camps, resource vouchers plus more. Note that the merchant will open his business once your HQ reaches level 8 and that he will not be always in your Base. 

[h1]Army presets[/h1]
Now there is a faster way to deploy your army - the Army Presets! They will give you 5 individual slots to fill in with your army formations, so you can cover more scenarios and be as efficient as possible in the next battle. You will be able to access and create your Army Presets through the Airfield’s menu once it reaches level 15. 

[h1]Deployment Platform[/h1]
Now there is a new Logistics’ building – the Deployment Platform, and it will increase your March Size limit by a flat value. 

[h1]Other improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Airport menu polish 
[*] 260 More Faction Researches

[*] Various minor bug fixes and improvements.
[/list]

These could be highly desirable power-ups, exclusive boosts, basic and advanced crafting materials from the current Renegade camps, resource vouchers plus more. Note that the merchant will open his business once your HQ reaches level 8 and that he will not be always in your Base. 

[h1]Army presets[/h1]
Now there is a faster way to deploy your army - the Army Presets! They will give you 5 individual slots to fill in with your army formations, so you can cover more scenarios and be as efficient as possible in the next battle. You will be able to access and create your Army Presets through the Airfield’s menu once it reaches level 15. 

[h1]Deployment Platform[/h1]
Now there is a new Logistics’ building – the Deployment Platform, and it will increase your March Size limit by a flat value. 

[h1]Other improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Airport menu polish 
[*] 260 More Faction Researches
[*] Realm merge polish - We have added pre world merge event in which the winning factions will get continental harbors as a rewards in the new world.
[*] Elite Mines polish - The depleted state of the mines will be 8 hours but the gathering speed will be increased by 30%. 
[*] Streamlined chat experience – improved filtering of offensive words, better chat editing options on Windows (copy-paste is now possible)
[*] Battle Visual Polish – we have added craters as post impact/death effects 
[*] Base Overview menu rework -  now boosts that give the same type of bonuses don’t stack 
[*] Various minor bug fixes and improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 3 Live!
notes.content:
Hi Generals, 
Update 3 is here and it makes for a global conquest that’s heaps more exciting! World merge, new limited-time event, daily missions and renegades from a different faction are all breaking through to challenge your military ambitions and bring a reward-bombing down on you. 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31144110/4d03bdb305e77160adc66442fa64db91985cdeed.jpg[/img]

[h1]World Merge Ahead![/h1]
All the brave Generals that have brought peace and prosperity to their World will collide as they are called up to conquer and establish control over new Worlds. The fight will be intense, but at the end only the strongest will prevail in the struggle for power over the new territories. 
The first world merge will take place after a yes/no survey results are announced. After the players are moved to their new world, they will receive rewards. For all players: 1 Elite Teleport, 3 Faction Teleports, 1 Player Name Change and 10,000 Medals. For players from factions that had controlled a continental hub before the merge: additional 10,000 Medals and Resources.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31144110/7ac1a7f6f58faa32b9ca9da752e93da23a22d74b.jpg[/img]

[h1]Daily Missions[/h1]
Complete objectives on a daily basis and be rewarded for your endeavors and consistency. Access all your Daily Missions from the new in-base HUD where you will be able to quickly navigate through the separate tasks. The more tasks you complete, the more points you will receive, which will help you reach the threshold rewards.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31144110/994b1ead88b62abf0e0fcfe4f7d5416c7de254f2.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Event - Lucky Spin![/h1]
Spin it to win it! Test your luck with the new Lucky Spin event! You can go for the normal or the premium High Roller. Each chip you spend will grant you different amount of points - collect as many points as possible to reach the third event milestone and claim your military rewards.

[h1]Meet the new Renegades: the Prototype Corps![/h1]
Full of mischief, these new renegades are coming for no fun but to strike terror with their naughty war vehicles. Defeat the Prototype Corps and you will have the chance to obtain new seasonal materials which you can use to craft exclusive powerful equipment sets.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31144110/bc4acfd3c49a419974966f54ae083deae5994aee.jpg[/img]

[h1]Other improvements[/h1]
•	New levels of each faction research type – we are adding 5 new levels of each military faction research type, 5 new levels for the Faction Province Limit research and 2 brand new researches - Thorium Production (15 levels) and Crafting Speed (20 levels).
•	Better boss renegades re-spawn rate
•	Crafting and Tech Factory – polished crafting menu for better and smoother crafting experience 
•	2 New Faction flags
•	Renegade Base visual improvements  
•	Other bug fixes and improvements (e.g. battle reports)
